bullets.text: BT's Sovereign Platform Launched - **BT** introduces a new platform for UK businesses, enhancing control over networks and data.
ISPs Must Innovate - **Incognito** highlights the need for ISPs to offer value-added services to retain customers.
Virgin Media Fined £23.8m - **Ofcom** penalizes **Virgin Media** for endangering vulnerable customers during digital migration.
Cloudflare Outage Exposes Risks - The recent **Cloudflare** outage reveals vulnerabilities in enterprise infrastructure reliance.
Wi-Fi 8 and AI Integration - The future of **Wi-Fi** is shifting towards managed solutions, enhancing reliability and performance.
AWS Targets Sovereign AI - **AWS** launches AI Factories, challenging telcos in the sovereign AI market.
Automated Threats Dominate Security - 2026 will see a focus on automated threats and cloud resilience in cybersecurity.
Telcos Embrace AI Services - Telecoms are evolving to offer AI-as-a-Service, leveraging existing infrastructure for new revenue.
Vodacom Gains Majority in Safaricom - **Vodacom** increases its stake in **Safaricom**, enhancing its market position in Kenya.
Keysight's New RF Analyzers - **Keysight** introduces handheld RF analyzers for precise field testing in challenging environments.
